title: SurvivalCraft SMP
description:
This server adds new custom features and don't deletes vannila mechanics.
No toxic players!
and private block to create a region where can build you and your friends!
just join from java or bedrock and start /rtp for /help
body:
Welcome to SurvivalCraft! This server adds new features but not deletes vannila.
### Core features
- Ah (You can sell your items or buy it running /ah)
- economy (This is a continue of ah and many more to known your balance run /balance)
- /rtp (Yes you can just run /rtp and start gaming)
- tpa (You can request teleport to player)
- region blocks (Yes you can save your build just run /ps get and place the block you get)
- Team (You can chat in team Just add ! to your message in start of it without space, to create a team you need to run /team create {name of your team}
- This is all of core features! All features you can see joining our server, For having to watch updates go to our discord
# Server has voice chat to use it please install mod plasmo voice
Or if you can't just install it from our site to play with optimization and voice chat
